_comment: RAG evaluation reference set. Each item is a question with its GROUND-TRUTH source (human-asserted). Matching is by file basename + page, so the 'pdf/' or 'pptx/' prefix and minor filename variants don't matter. Questions whose expect_file is NOT currently embedded are SKIPPED (not failed), so this set can grow as documents are added. Negative cases (expect_file=null) assert the system should NOT confidently match — used for confidence calibration.
